method: Area-weighted remaining native cell-years divided by aggregate observed Spark throughput; planning range adds unmeasured preparation/download/analysis/review allowance and larger-tile uncertainty. Range is a planning estimate, not a statistical confidence interval.
assumptions: Mac remains awake and processing continuously
Internet and source server remain available
No new validation failures or storage issues
limitations: Only two tile sizes have been observed; larger remaining tiles may spill or slow down
Recorded Spark durations exclude acquisition/preparation/publication and downstream analysis
Multi-hour timestamp gaps exceed recorded Spark durations; interrupted runs can take much longer in calendar time
